24x7 for emergencies only. All routine maintenance must be done on a Mondays with the approval of the General Manager of the country club but must also check in with American Tower. 
This is an American Tower site. American Tower site reference ID is 210059. You must check in with American Tower NOC, 877-518-6937, gnoc@americantower.com, before entering compound, along with notifying the General Manager Joe Napolitano of the Country Club, whose information is below.

•	Primary Contact: General Manager Joe Napolitano (jnapolitano@bonniebriar.org, 914-834-0992 ext. 252).
•	Standard Access: Requires at least 3 days’ advance notice via email to the General Manager. Routine maintenance is limited to Mondays, or Tuesdays during Holiday Weekends.
•	Emergency Access: Permitted, but the General Manager must still be notified.
•	Construction Window: Allowed only between November 1 and April 1; coordination with the General Manager is required.

BTS Access: 24x7 for emergencies only. All non-emergency access must be scheduled. 
•	6160, B160, PPC, and Charles Cube (AAV)
•	1x BB 6672, 1x IXR-E
•	3x strings 190ah Batteries
•	1x 10g AAV unit

Tower Access: This is a Mono_Pine tower so all tower work must be done with manlift or crane. Climbing is not permitted on this tower.
•	4 Sectors
•	1x 4480, 1x 4460, 1x APXVAALL24M-U-J20 antenna per sector

Power Access: 24x7 for emergencies only. All non-emergency access must be scheduled. 
•	Power meter is located outside of the compound to the left of the entrance. 
•	PPC is located on the TMO platform across from BTS 6160. 
•	Back-up power is 3x strings of 190ah batteries in B160 cabinet. 
•	Generator deployment restrictions will be confirmed soon. For now, no GEN deployment. 
•	CAM Locks for GEN Connection on PPC

Telco Access: 24x7 for emergencies only. All non-emergency access must be scheduled. 
•	10G AAV
•	AAV Vendor is LightPath 
•	AAV cube power is connected to 6160, backed up by 3 strings of 190ah batteries.

Government / Military Compound:  Access hours ONLY Monday -- Friday: 9am to 4pm with advance notice and approval!!

TO ACCESS SITE FOR ANY REASON, Contact POC: William Harrison | Chief Engineer, WETA-FM: wharrison@weta.org | 703-998-2600 or 571-867-0683.
He relays your info to the military police at the security checkpoint. A military police officer will follow you in their vehicle from security checkpoint to tower.
This is a Capitol Police secured site for Camp David / Presidential communications facility. 
There is a Pentagon Police Checkpoint before Tower compound so you may need to provide William with the following:
Company, full legal name, social security number, date of birth and place of birth
You will need to provide your vehicle make / model / tag. 
William currently has vehicle make / model / tag for FOPS Josh Ross and Mike Dietrich. 
You should provide 10 days notice to LL of any scheduled work and receive LL written consent. Must provide personnel list. 
If FOPS site visit for alarm, contact William ASAP but doesn’t need to be 10 days advance, that’s for construction.
Compound gate combo is 1719. 
To get through security in a timely manner please drive a vehicle that is not full of tools, make sure it is basically empty. 
You cannot have any open food containers or food trash in the vehicle. 
It is also highly recommended to take photos facing away from the Army communications equipment that are directly adjacent to the tower compound.

LAYH043A and extension routers LAY4301A- LAY4314A in TBIT are located in the middle row rack #2 and #3 towards the end. TMO patch panel to SAS main router is at top of rack#1 middle row.  BTS BB are located in in 1st row, the front rack#1 and #2. Extension routers LAY4315A to LAY4319A and BB are located in MSC. MSC routers fibers are patched from TBIT patch panel. 
Site has 10G circuit.  ATT circuit / TMO handoff from ATT/and patch panel to the router is located in MPOE. MPOE is located in TBIT bldg. through door #3C10-03A in airfield. To get to this room, go out of “COMM LAWA” room and walk towards the opposite side, take elevator to 1 and exit elevator, once exit look straight ahead and you will see #3C10-03A double door. Go through this door and you will see MPOE room. 

All TBIT sites are DAS/DOT system located throughout Tom Bradley International Airport (TBIT). Therefore, if DOT is faulty will need to arrange with Aztecs to replace at night. All MSC sites ( LAY4315A - LAY4319A)  are radio units mounted in same room as routers and BB in MSC. No generator can be deployed, LAX power.
